external_entities.name: Library member
external_entities.description: A member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks to borrow, renew, reserve, borrow, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Staff who use the circulation page to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books as returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: An app on members' phones that calls the lending API for borrowing, renewing, and reserving books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that handles loans, reservations, and account-related lending changes, and reads and writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note states: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript states: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting positive claims, so exposure is unknown.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books, and which sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing member names, email addresses, home addresses, borrowing history, loans, and reservations.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: use library app
data_flows.description: A library member uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Books, member and loan or reservation information

data_flows.name: manage loans
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with member and book information for borrowing, renewing, and reserving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.
data_flows.data_description: Book, member, loan, and reservation information

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends each loan and return to the lending API as scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: Member, book, loan, and return information

data_flows.name: change loan account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; the history records that a loan was closed by hand but cannot identify the person or branch.
data_flows.data_description: Member account, loan, block, and return information

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: Member phone
trust_boundaries.description: A member's phone, where the library app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where self-service kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network over which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and full member borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The interview states that the loans database contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and every member's full borrowing history.
